snippet.title: Homunculus Hotel - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Here at the Homunculus Hotel, every room is a story and we help lost spirits find their way through their past dreams.

For the first time, we will let outsiders explore a tiny bit of what we offer through the eyes of one of our helpers: Isabelle.
Take part in our open day on September 25th and discover our special rooms!

Free access here:
https://team-soletude.itch.io/homunculus-hotel
